original_test_intent: Change one verified settable sensor's Sensor Type and Event/Reading Type codes over OOB, demonstrate that the sensor and event interpretation remain coherent, then restore both original codes.
original_method: Master remains TBD. Review identifies IPMI v2.0 Table 35-16 raw 0x04/0x2E <sensor number> <sensor type> <event/reading type> with Table 35-17 0x2F baseline/readback.
manual_activity: The monitoring owner approves the dedicated target, exact sensor, supported new Sensor Type/Event-Reading Type pair, expected downstream interpretation, maintenance window and restoration.
required_inputs: Proof that the sensor supports Set Sensor Type
Expected reading, status and event decoder behavior
Exact restore payload and independent recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not copy codes from display text without protocol validation
Validate standard, OEM and reserved code ranges
Do not change thresholds, factors or event-enable masks
Stop on missing sensor, invalid reading or monitoring loss
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, sensor and settable capability
Capture raw 0x2F, SDR, reading and event baseline
Validate the proposed type pair and downstream decoder compatibility
Present the exact three request data bytes for confirmation
Read back with 0x2F and observe bounded reading/event behavior
Restore both original codes and reverify
engineer_actions: Approve the supported type pair and expected semantics
Own recovery if the sensor disappears or restore fails

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly refuses the TBD mutation; a generic sensor display cannot safely choose a new type pair or prove settable support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, capture raw 0x04 0x2f <sensor>, issue one secret-safe raw 0x04 0x2e <sensor> <sensor-type> <event-reading-type>, verify exact 0x2F readback and bounded reading/event interpretation, then restore the original pair.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: No Master sensor or type value is invented; source TBD and 10/5 timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the two type bytes as a coupled schema change: validate support and decoder compatibility, perform one write, verify identity plus actual reading/event semantics, and restore the complete pair.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a reversible Review-layer procedure while preserving the Master TBD.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A 0x2F read or sensor-info display cannot satisfy the setter; this case does not rewrite SDR content, factors, thresholds or event enables.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A syntactically accepted but semantically incompatible type pair can cause software to decode valid bytes as the wrong sensor or event class.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only if it targets the same settable sensor, exposes both raw type codes, validates compatibility and supports exact restoration.
expected_evidence: Owner approval and dedicated target/sensor/SDR identity
Settable capability and original 0x2F type pair
Restored type pair and no-collateral-change audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title consistently identifies Set Sensor Type while Procedure and Criteria are TBD. Missing target, values, semantic oracle and recovery plus generic log clearing are source omissions rather than contradictory requirements; the conditional Review mapping preserves Master TBD.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard operation is identifiable. Settable capability, supported type pair, expected behavior and restore data are Project readiness inputs; execution must become BLOCKED if compatibility cannot be proven.

review_improvement: Treats Sensor Type and Event/Reading Type as a coupled semantic contract, requires behavioral proof beyond readback and preserves an exact two-field restoration path.
independent_technical_reasoning: Changing Sensor Type or Event/Reading Type changes how all downstream software interprets the same sensor number, reading and event bits. A completion code and 0x2F echo can both succeed while monitoring semantics are broken. The test therefore needs a vendor-supported pair, bounded reading/event validation and restoration of both original bytes as one atomic recovery objective.
